_about: Back Seat Driver rows (settings audit, 2026-09-26): one spelling (advisor), pickers for model and persona, the compaction point as a percentage.

safety.approvals.bsd-mode.label: Advisor
safety.approvals.bsd-mode.help: Auto checks in at key moments. Always watching checks in all the time.
safety.approvals.bsd-mode.about: A separate read-only advisor that watches your work and raises concerns. Auto runs it at the moments that usually matter, Always watching checks in all the time, Off turns it off. It never approves, changes or certifies anything, and your work carries on normally if it fails.

safety.approvals.bsd-model.label: Model it uses
safety.approvals.bsd-model.help: Its usage is shown separately from your main work.

hints.Default: Puppet Master picks a signed-in model

safety.approvals.bsd-persona.label: How it talks
safety.approvals.bsd-persona.help: Critical Advisor is blunt about risk. Add your own under Personas.

safety.approvals.bsd-trigger-sensitivity.label: How readily it speaks up
safety.approvals.bsd-trigger-sensitivity.help: How small a problem has to be before it says something.
safety.approvals.bsd-trigger-sensitivity.about: How readily the advisor speaks up. Balanced raises concerns and serious problems but stays quiet about small things.

safety.approvals.bsd-catch-up-seconds.label: Time to catch up on missed work
safety.approvals.bsd-catch-up-seconds.help: After this it skips ahead to what is happening now.
safety.approvals.bsd-catch-up-seconds.about: How long the advisor may spend catching up on work that happened while it was busy, before it skips ahead to what is happening now.

safety.approvals.bsd-cooldown-turns.label: Quiet turns after advice
safety.approvals.bsd-cooldown-turns.help: So it does not repeat itself.
safety.approvals.bsd-cooldown-turns.about: How many turns the advisor stays quiet after speaking, so it does not repeat itself.

safety.approvals.bsd-retain-transcript.label: Keep the advisor's conversation
safety.approvals.bsd-retain-transcript.help: Lets you open it and see why it said something.
safety.approvals.bsd-retain-transcript.about: Keeps the advisor's own conversation so you can open it and see why it said something.

safety.approvals.bsd-self-compact-thresh.label: Tidy its own notes when this full
safety.approvals.bsd-self-compact-thresh.help: 50 to 95%. It never touches your conversation.
safety.approvals.bsd-self-compact-thresh.about: How full the advisor's own context gets before it compacts itself. Its compaction never touches your conversation.

planning.verification.back-seat-driver-m.label: Back Seat Driver (planning copy)
planning.verification.back-seat-driver-m.help: The same switch as the advisor's mode, kept for older plans. It follows the Advisor setting.
